exposure: type of perineal tears (clitoral and periclitoral tears, high-degree perineal lacerations)
outcome: overall Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) scores
cohort: The study involved 80 primiparous women who delivered vaginally.
finding: Three months after vaginal delivery, 56.2% of primiparous women developed early sexual dysfunction, with marital status (marriage as protective) and type of perineal tears (clitoral and periclitoral tears associated with higher risk) identified as key influencing factors.
mod_finding: At three months post vaginal delivery, 56.2% of primiparous women developed early sexual dysfunction.
